176: === Custom Widgets ===
177: 
178: A custom widget can be embedded into a decision.
179: GUI files must be placed at the decision_view_widgets path (see paths.settings). The name of the file must match the widget name.
180: 
181: Usually these widgets require a custom controller. This should be documented in the widget's GUI file.
182: The data context type available in the GUI depends on the controller type.
183: 
184: Available controllers:
185: 
186: Controller Type						| Data Context Name				  		| Notes
187: ------------------------------------+---------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------
188: default								| EventWindowWidget				  		| Default controller, no special behavior
189: create_holy_order 					| DecisionViewWidgetCreateHolyOrder  	| Show GUI to customize the new holy order.
